status: Secondary research question frozen while the two-child engine run was in flight, before seeing rank or destination results. Uses only the already scheduled root boards. Retain the original primary endpoint and report both.
prior: The R1 H1 geometry study measured distance to the last human move. The previous ladder study labeled tactical destinations post hoc when a safe straight escape was bypassed. Here use the pre-action locations of two independent engine alternatives to estimate which player choices occupy the same region even though the precise point differs. This is an operational geometric label, not a direct measure of intent.
population: Use original policy menu filters and only positions with two distinct top candidates at Manhattan distance <=4. First outcome is whether the actual move is exactly one of those two. For the remaining non-pass moves, the new outcome is whether the played point is within Manhattan distance <=3 of either candidate. Keep passes in the first head and report their count. Freeze both distances for every split.
model: Two-stage grade-conditional Bernoulli likelihood. Both heads use grade-neutral intercept, log prior ratio, joint policy mass, phase, root lead magnitude, candidate distance, proximity of opponent's previous move to either candidate, and opponent pass. Grade-specific effects for intercept, policy mass, phase and candidate distance. Fit balanced by player within grade and grades equally with the same fixed ridge as the primary model. Sum centered evidence in each head per question, divided by sqrt(max(1, number observed in that head)). First calibrate nonnegative [0,2] coefficient for exact hits vs SQ4, then the coefficient of within-region evidence over that baseline, using disjoint fold 1 predicts fold 2 and vice versa. Freeze, refit on 1/2 and test 3/4 with the original SQ4 guard. Negative control permutes near versus far responses at unique missed positions inside fold and fresh status, phase [84,148], prior mass [.5,.7], candidate distance [2.5] and last-opponent-to-candidate distance [3.5,8.5]. Seed 20261124.
estimation: Report all 10 grades, detailed 1D/2D and 3D/4D. At non-pass misses compare higher-minus-lower probability of staying within 3 of either engine point matched across phase, prior mass, candidate distance and opponent-last-distance cells, using harmonic common-support weights and 4000 draws of whole players resampled within grade. Repeat on the 11,050 additional games of the same test owners. Report 5/10/20 median exact and missed opportunities, same-player 10-game/10-game correlation for local rate (all twenty predetermined splits) and pairwise player-bootstrap competition intervals. Call a candidate only with >=.001 vs SQ4, both eval folds positive and 95% lower endpoints above zero vs both SQ4 and exact-only. This second screened hypothesis would need new players if it advances.
